question: The major component of granite is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**SiO2 and Al2O3.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Granite:-**

 
 
• **Granite is a type of intrusive igneous rock that is formed when magma cools and solidifies underground. **
 
• It is one of the most common rocks in the Earth's crust, and it is found in all continents.
 
• Granite is a hard, durable, and strong rock that is often used as a building material.
 
• **SiO₂ (silicon dioxide) and Al₂O₃ (alumina) are the major components of granite. **
 
• SiO₂ makes up about 60-75% of granite, while Al₂O₃ makes up about 10-20%. The remaining 5-15% of granite is made up of other minerals, such as feldspar, quartz, and mica.
